# restate_cloud_region_grant (Data Source)

An existing region grant of the account or of its organization, looked up by ID.

Use it where one configuration manages an organization's grant and others build regions with it: check `status` before creating a `restate_cloud_byoc_region`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An organization's grant, managed by another configuration, that this account builds regions with.
data "restate_cloud_region_grant" "shared" {
  id = var.region_grant_id
}

check "grant_is_ready" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.restate_cloud_region_grant.shared.status == "READY"
    error_message = "Region grant ${var.region_grant_id} is ${data.restate_cloud_region_grant.shared.status}, so no region can be built with it."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Grant ID to look up, for example `rgr_x5z2y4qjmt`.

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the grant is in: `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) AWS account ID, GCP project ID or Azure subscription ID the grant is in.
- `confirmed_at` (String) When Restate confirmed the grant. Empty while it is `PENDING`.
- `created_at` (String) When the grant was created.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown for the grant.
- `owner` (String) `ACCOUNT` or `ORGANIZATION`.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the account or organization that owns the grant.
- `region_ids` (List of String) Regions built with the grant that are not deleted yet.
- `resource_prefix` (String) Prefix of every resource name a region of the grant has in the cloud account. Empty once the grant has ended.
- `status` (String) `PENDING`, `READY`, `EXPIRED` or `DELETED`. Regions can be built only with a `READY` grant.
- `status_message` (String) With `CONFIRMATION_FAILED`: the cloud's answer to Restate's sign-in.
- `status_reason` (String) While the grant is `PENDING`: `AWAITING_CONFIRMATION`, `CONFIRMING` or `CONFIRMATION_FAILED`.
